column3: “Deeds”, “them”, and “these years” replace the singular work and “the midst of years”.
“Rays” renders the two horns figuratively; “sunlight” specifies light.
“You called for many arrows” replaces the terse sequence of oaths, rods, and a word.
“Stripped him from head to toe” replaces laying bare the foundation up to the neck.
“His own spear” is singular instead of plural; “his head” replaces the head of his warriors, and “us” replaces “me”.
“Churning” is supplied before the great waters.
“My” is omitted before the heights and the stringed instruments; “deer” does not specify the female.
